allocation: uniform node-index order: four samples per node, then distribute remainder by quotient and node-index remainder; every arm sees identical target prefixes

policies.frozen_source: predict from source posterior mean with no target update
policies.scratch: Gaussian linear posterior with zero mean and isotropic precision 0.25
policies.warm_source: Gaussian linear posterior with source mean and source covariance as prior

scoring: MSE on the existing independent 1024-point target test design, grouped into all, changed, and unchanged nodes; no labels or latent coefficients passed to policy fitting
custody: source posterior hashes must match preflight receipts; exact target-prefix counts and identical actions across arms; per-cell hashes and source revision in complete receipts
interpretation_gate: At 200 target examples, report each family/coefficient and changed-count stratum separately. A useful warm-source prior must beat scratch on untouched nodes without raising changed-node error by more than 5% in every stratum at both source sample sizes. This is a development diagnostic only; no method is promoted to fresh confirmation solely on this gate.
forbidden: No latent source/target coefficient, changed-node label, target test response, private result, or closed-model output enters a policy. No adaptive allocation or switch is selected after looking at these scores.
